seed_selection: Nearest already published visual anchor to six preselected pilot times; no annotation coordinates used.
camera_compensation: Moving crop centered on seed point transformed by floor homographies; approximate for non-floor objects. Reject explicit edit range.
purpose: Compare learned spatiotemporal point propagation against the sparse detector baseline; output proposals, not automatically accepted tracking.
selection: On development seed intervals only, maximize within_25px - 3*outside_25px, then within_12px, then fewer outside_25px. Compare frozen filtered variants; report validation separately. All references are reused development observations.
evaluation: Same six seeds and camera-compensated windows as prior TAPNext++ pilot. Exclude every seed and its +-3 frames. Compare raw mask centers and shape/appearance-filtered centers. No labels used as inference prompts.
fusion: Retain original visual anchors. Compare appearance-filtered TAPNext++ and SAM. If agreeing within 25 native pixels choose the higher appearance score; otherwise prefer the higher score only if its margin is at least 0.2, and retain TAP on smaller conflicts. Keep the final output one position.
audit: Inspect 24 added or changed candidate positions selected evenly by time after freezing outputs. Review before/after native crops; include visible errors and unclear cases. Do not treat unknown ball locations as correct.
scope: NBHL ball hockey, same previously examined five-minute recording; no independent or new-game accuracy claim. No model weight fine-tuning in this experiment.
